profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Suncoast Credit Union
profile.summary: Dustin is a hard-working, fast-learning, jack-of-all trades developer who has satisfied 50+ clients throughout his 6 year career. He has primarily been working in web/mobile development, but also has lots of backend and dev ops experience as well.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Xamarin/Maui: 
- Upgrading to .NET 8, MUAI 
- Enhancing app with notifications through Azure/Firebase/APNS
- Upgrading SDK’s to support latest features like Face ID and other biometric authentication Added
Azure Dev ops:
- Creating/maintaining Azure devops CI/CD pipelines
- Creating new repo’s and setting up policies
Flutter: 
Architecture design and development for new front end platform

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: After being asked to rejoin Credera on a part time basis, it turned into a full time project working with Golds Gym's main website and e-commerce site.  I have been the lead developer managing feature pushes, code changes and dev ops support. Project stack is Angular 1, php, Laravel, Wordpress, Twigg, and MySql.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
At Surge, I am a part of a fully distributed software development company. I get to work out of my home in Jasper Texas and work with clients and teammates from across the nation.  

Platforms: Xamarin, iOS, WordPress 

Languages: C#, Swift, PHP, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Mobile Architect
positions.description:
Established FanReact’s long term mobile strategy and execution scheme
Architected and implemented entire mobile platform using MVVM with extensibility in mind
Interviewed, hired, and lead team of four to meet critical deadlines
Designed app for easy white-labeling for FanReact’s multiple partners
Delivered reusable libraries deployed in CI for new white-lable apps to leverage 
Developed and published iOS and Android applications to the Apple and Play stores

positions.title: Consultant in Mobile Development practice
positions.description:
I have worked with many fortune 1000 companies serving them in overcoming their most difficult technology problems with creative solutions. I have work on many iOS applications, cross-platform applications, single page web apps, and restful API services. 

Roles:
Developer, Task Manager, Consultant, Local University Recruiter, Lead Office Purchaser and Expense Reporter

Languages:
Swift, Objective-C, C#, Angular JS, Java, Node JS, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, SQLite

Software:
Xcode, Visual Studio, Xamarin, Brackets, Eclipse, Source Tree, Visio

Platforms
iOS, Cross-platform, Wordpress, Web Apps, RESTful APIs, Android, Mac store, Windows Universal
